none: PAS FindID 990221: An incomplete Roman copper alloy Radiate of Claudius II (AD 268 - 270)

An incomplete Roman copper alloy Radiate of Claudius II ( AD 268 - 270), struck after his death, dating to the period AD 270-271 (Reece period 13). CONSECRATIO reverse type depicting an alter with flame above. Obverse description: Right facing radiate bust. Obverse inscription: [..]. Reverse description: Altar and flames. Reverse inscription: [CON]SEC[RATIO]. Dimensions: 15.04mm; weight: 0.89 g
